purpose: Feasibility work for a phase III trial: we want to know where enough people with poorly controlled diabetes live so we can select recruiting sites.
question: How many adults with type 2 diabetes whose latest HbA1c is above 8% are there in each region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Use the latest HbA1c (LOINC 4548-4) per patient; patients without an HbA1c are left out.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes and poorly controlled HbA1c.
